teams.lead: Four of ART Grand Prix's five were won in GP2, and the fifth came in 2023, six years after the championship changed its name
teams.note: GP2 ran from 2005 to 2016 and became the FIA Formula 2 Championship in 2017, so this record reaches across two championships under one label. ART Grand Prix won the teams' title in the very first GP2 season, running Nico Rosberg and Alexandre Prémat, defended it in 2006 with Lewis Hamilton, and added 2009 and 2015 before the rebrand. Its only Formula 2 teams' championship is 2023, the year Théo Pourchaire took the drivers' title with the same team. Prema Racing and DAMS have three apiece — Prema in 2016, 2020 and 2021, DAMS in 2012, 2014 and 2019 — and neither has won one since. Twenty-one seasons have produced eleven different teams' champions, and the current holders, Invicta Racing, took their first two in 2024 and 2025.
